children: Wabash National reported Q2 revenue of $417M, a $0.53 adjusted diluted loss per share and a backlog of $956M.
Q2 revenue $417M; GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders $(22.9)M and adjusted diluted loss per share $(0.53).
Backlog expanded to $956M, up 14% QoQ, supporting revenue visibility into 2027.
Entered $150M of convertible senior notes in July to enhance balance sheet strength and agility.
Q3 2026 outlook: revenue midpoint $450M, operating margin midpoint (4.0%) and EPS midpoint $(0.45).
Free cash flow turned positive in Q2 at $3.1M vs. $(22.8)M prior year; net cash provided by operating activities $5.1M.
